introduction.description:
Formed in 2021 by six players: Nakahara Masato, Kawasaki Manami, Fujisaki Kenta, Noguchi Arata, Matsubara Akane, and Suga Kosuke.
A unique ensemble whose members all perform independently, without belonging to any traditional school.

Beyond the folk songs at the heart of Tsugaru shamisen, the group performs original pieces with modern rhythms and harmonies, exploring new possibilities for the Tsugaru shamisen ensemble.

contact.requestBody:
We perform at parties, ceremonies, festivals, and other events.
The program and performance length can be flexibly arranged to suit your event.
contact.requestFirstStep: Please feel free to contact us by email or phone and tell us about the event you have in mind.
contact.songsBody: We perform a wide range of music, including traditional folk songs, contemporary pieces, and covers. The program can be tailored to your event.
contact.priceBase:
Full ensemble of 6 players
30 minutes: from ¥200,000 (tax included)
contact.priceExtra: An additional fee applies if you would like us to perform in traditional Japanese attire. Travel expenses are charged separately.
contact.priceSmallGroup: Depending on the size of the venue, your budget, and the atmosphere you are looking for, we can also perform as a smaller group of 2 to 5 players.
contact.priceProposal: After hearing your requests, we will propose the best plan for your event. Please feel free to contact us.
contact.priceDisclaimer: * Prices shown are a guide only. Fees may vary depending on the program, time commitment, and venue location.
contact.languageNote: We can respond in English or Japanese.
